general.intro: Placement and dimensions are configured above. Group scope uses the selected group; page and all pages use the viewport.

actions.note: Actions are sortable. IDs stay stable when actions move and can be used by patch and remove messages.

hint.general:
• Scope: Group = inside a dashboard group, Page = floating on one page, All pages = floating everywhere.
  • Order / Width / Height: grid placement, only for Group.
hint.button:
• Icon: PrimeIcons name with pi- prefix, e.g. pi-plus (list).
  • Background / Color: hex only (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa), pick with the color chooser or type; no color names.
  • Label / Tooltip: plain text, no HTML.
  • Size 11-96 px, Radius 0-48 px, Offsets 0-500 px.
hint.menu:
• Mode: speed-dial = icon buttons, menu = labelled list (always linear).
  • Shape: linear, circle, semi-circle, quarter-circle. Direction: offered according to shape and button position; linear rows adjust automatically near screen edges.
  • Radius 0-500 px (0 = automatic), circle shapes only.
  • Gap 0-48 px, Duration 0-1000 ms, Action size 44-80 px.
hint.actions:
• Id: unique and stable, letters/digits/_ . : -, max. 64 characters; sent as msg.action.
  • Icon: pi-… name (list). Colors: hex only.
  • Payload: choose string, number, boolean or JSON (objects, arrays, null).
  • Topic: optional msg.topic. Hidden or disabled actions send nothing.
hint.theme:
• Background / Color: hex only (#rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa); empty uses the mode default.
  • Radius 0-40 px, Z index 1-10000.

inputHelp.1: Send a complete action array as msg.payload to replace all actions. An object can update actions, button, menu, and/or theme; supplied button, menu, and theme fields are merged into their current section.
inputHelp.2: msg.command = "patch" applies partial action objects in msg.payload by stable ID. remove removes IDs listed in the payload array. reset restores the editor configuration. Unknown and duplicate IDs are rejected. Typed editor payloads are converted to native string, number, boolean, or JSON values; JSON null is valid, while an absent required payload is invalid.
inputHelp.3: For per-client changes, target active sockets with msg._client.socketId and/or msg._client.clientId. Enable this node under Dashboard Client Data / Accepts Client Data first. Client IDs match connected sockets only. A shared update clears client overrides; disconnecting a client discards its override.
inputHelp.4: Reduced motion is automatic. The menu closes on Escape and outside click. These behaviors are always enabled.
